ops.text: Release tags must be signed with the fleet release key (F3299DE3FE0F6C3CF2B66BFBF7ECDD88A700D73A), but git tag -s picks the configured default signing key (an EDDSA personal key), and nothing preflights the mismatch: verify-tag-on-main fails only AFTER the push, and the repo ruleset makes tags immutable, so the wrongly-signed v0.20.0 tag is burned forever (it remains a valid Go module version but can never release; v0.20.1 re-cut it). A local preflight — release-check.sh verifying the tag signer fingerprint before push, or a git alias/hook that forces -u <fleet-key> for v* tags — would have saved a burned tag.
